items.title: Segro Shares Rise After Board Yields to Prologis’s Final $18.7 Billion Takeover Bid

items.title: British data centre owner set for £14bn US takeover

items.title: Segro’s board will back Prologis’ $18.7B takeover bid

items.title: Prologis Makes Final $18.7 Billion Bid to Take Over U.K.’s Segro
items.summary: Prologis—the world’s largest owner of industrial real estate—has made a 9.5% increase over its initial proposal to take over its smaller U.K. rival, ruling out further rises.

items.title: Prologis (PLD) Stock Looks Above Fair Value As 42% Run Cools
items.summary: After a strong 41.8% 1 year return, Prologis now faces a valuation debate, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to a premium while market based multiples suggest the stock looks roughly in line with peers. Prologis has returned 41.8% over the past year, which means new buyers are no longer looking at a stock that obviously trades at a discount.
